change: Inline heterogeneous primitive unions, corrected general equality payload reads, and adjacent-block/boolean lowering. Matches native program/runtime source across compiler hosts; does not isolate these changes from each other.

staticRunBody.interpretation: The inline body is larger, but removes the numeric constructor/allocation from the repeated store path. Static whole-body counts are not dynamic instruction counts.

benchmark.method: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V0 user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.

test262.equivalence: Same two post-entry timeout classifications as the accepted register-copy baseline; timeout classification is not proof of identical completed values. Original resources, source hashes, strictness and 300000 ms budget retained.
test262.timing: 468875.568 ms Node batch wall; no compile CPU ledger for this run. Sloppy inferior CPU snapshot 178.3 s at 205 elapsed; strict CPU unavailable. No execution-speed claim from the timeouts.

selfbuild: Frozen native validation in progress: v3 reuses immutable v2 stage1 and source, compiler source e4cf68d5. The v2 live native run ended with the user-message session interruption after 388.745 CPU s, without a final image. This is not a semantic failure; logs and input image retained.
wholeSuiteProjection: No projection from a primitive-union store loop. Whole-suite throughput also depends on Node compilation, sparse array access, JIT preparation and execution distribution.
